label: Propofol PK — Marsh (1991)

extraction.tier_rationale: Weight-proportional central volume; fixed micro-rate constants. Widely deployed (Diprifusor) but no age covariate.

Original Marsh ke0 (published value). The 'modified Marsh' (ke0=1.21) is a separate, widely-used variant captured in notes — a model-selection risk within a model family, represented as a documented variant rather than a confidence downgrade of the published value.

known_failure_modes.condition: elderly patients (age not a model covariate)
known_failure_modes.behavior: Weight-only structure ignores age-related reductions in clearance and increased sensitivity; tends to overshoot in the elderly.

predictive_performance.population: external validation, 50 elective surgical adults (head-to-head: Marsh 25%, Schnider 26%, Eleveld 22%)

developmental_model.caveat: Adult weight-only Marsh model carried into a neonate/infant by theory-based allometry PLUS the Anderson-Holford PMA clearance-maturation sigmoid. Tier-D by construction; the TM50/Hill are ILLUSTRATIVE propofol maturation parameters pending human source confirmation (the PMA-clock and TM50/Hill line items specifically). Not a pediatric dosing model.

extraction.tier_rationale: Allometry + PMA maturation extrapolation of an adult model; Tier-D by construction. TM50=47.7 wk, Hill=3.4 are illustrative (spec §4 example) pending verification against a propofol-specific maturation source.
Robust, decades of clinical deployment via the Diprifusor TCI system; weight-only covariate model limits accuracy outside mid-range adults. Record awaits human PDF verification of every constant.

source_review.reviewed_by: automated source cross-check (Claude Opus 4.8 via Hypnos research agents)
source_review.method: fetched open-access reproductions, primary-paper PubMed abstracts, FDA labels, and/or the tci R package source, then numerically compared each curated typical-value parameter against the fetched values (see sources)
sources: marsh-1991-propofol-pk (primary BJA; paywalled, not directly read)
source_review.notes: V1 0.228 L/kg and all five rate constants (k10 0.119, k12 0.112, k13 0.0419, k21 0.055, k31 0.0033) confirmed (tci rounds k13 to 0.042; curated k12 0.112 is the original-paper value vs 0.114 in Diprifusor software). ke0 is genuinely UNSETTLED in the literature: curated 0.26 is the original Diprifusor-era value; modern implementations (tci, 'modified Marsh') use 1.21 — a lineage/documentation choice. HUMAN ITEM: confirm the intended ke0 lineage.

notes: Micro-rate-constant parameterization. V2 = V1*k12/k21, V3 = V1*k13/k31 derived. The 'modified Marsh' variant differs only in ke0 (1.21 vs 0.26).
